name: ANGEL EGG ~ this is not my body ~
source:
young and timid UTA lives on the planet ARION,  full of angels. at a certain age they are supposed to grow feathery wings... but she ends up growing freaky meat tentacles.  it seems to be some kind of parasite - so why does nobody else want to help? poor UTA has to figure out whats wrong with her before the parasite eats her alive ...

[From [url=https://wondereater.itch.io/angelegg]itch.io[/url]]
